Published workshops will bring together participant setup, exercises, example data, recordings, and other materials from Breeding Insight training events.

## Recommended workshop structure

1. **Overview:** audience, prerequisites, learning objectives, instructors, and date.
2. **Before the workshop:** installation checks, accounts, data downloads, and a short validation exercise.
3. **Modules:** slides, live-code notes, exercises, and solutions.
4. **Example data:** versioned and small enough for participants to reproduce the exercises.
5. **After the workshop:** recordings, FAQ, updates, and links to maintained tutorials.

::: {.callout-note}
## Workshop materials are being prepared

Public workshop pages will appear here when their participant instructions and exercises are ready. In the meantime, use the [Learn library](learn.qmd) for maintained concepts, tutorials, and workflows.
:::

Authors preparing new training materials can follow the [resource standards](resources.qmd) for code visibility, callouts, checkpoints, exercises, and reproducibility.
